title: Energy Systems
hook: Spending your sharpest hours on email is why 4pm feels impossible.
statement: You don't manage time. You manage energy.
explainer: One peak hour beats three tired ones. Admin goes in the slumps.
sop: Track your energy hourly for 3 days.
Score Energy and Time Used at peaks.
Put your best work in the peaks.
equation_example: Energy 8 × Time Used 7 = 56. Protect more peak hours and that climbs.
question: Write down when you peak and what you do then.
closing_statement: Time without energy is just hours.
